jobs.occupation: Creative Buffet Chef – Winter Season 2026/2027
jobs.description:
Do you love preparing delicious prepared food, colourful salads and beautifully presented buffet dishes? Would you enjoy spending the winter in the Norwegian mountains?

Lillehammer Fjellstue is a small, family-run mountain lodge located at Nordseter, just 15 minutes from Lillehammer, Norway.

We are looking for a creative, independent and reliable chef to join our friendly international team for the winter season, starting in late December 2026.

We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys cooking, takes pride in preparing good food and appreciates working in a small, well-established team.

Our kitchen and food philosophy

At Lillehammer Fjellstue, we believe that good food doesn't have to be complicated.

Every morning, we serve a traditional Norwegian breakfast buffet with a selection of cold dishes.

In the evening, our guests enjoy a dinner buffet featuring a hot fish dish, a hot meat dish, soup, vegetarian options, fresh salads, cold fish and meat selections, and the dessert of the day.

We are not a large hotel with an extensive buffet selection. Instead, we focus on good good food, fresh ingredients, variety, attractive presentation and dishes our guests genuinely enjoy.

We value teamwork, mutual respect and a positive working atmosphere. Our chefs have clearly defined responsibilities but help each other whenever needed.

Your main responsibilities

Your primary responsibility will be preparing and presenting the cold section of our daily dinner buffet, including:

• 

Preparing and beautifully arranging platters with cold fish, meat and other savoury selections.

• 

Creating fresh, colourful salads, vegetable dishes and homemade dressings.

• 

Preparing homemade vegetarian pies, occasional pizzas and other simple vegetarian dishes.

• 

Preparing and arranging the cold breakfast buffet for the following morning.

• 

Presenting and replenishing the evening buffet during service.

• 

Planning daily preparations and food quantities according to guest numbers.

• 

Maintaining excellent food hygiene, safe food handling and a clean, organised kitchen.

We are flexible in how we divide responsibilities between our chefs.

Who are we looking for?

We would love to hear from someone who:

• 

Has relevant experience from a professional kitchen, restaurant, hotel or catering business.

• 

Enjoys preparing cold dishes, salads, vegetables and vegetarian food.

• 

Has a good eye for presentation and takes pride in making food both tasty and attractive.

• 

Can work independently, plan ahead and take responsibility for their own kitchen section.

• 

Has good knowledge of food hygiene, food safety and allergen management.

• 

Communicates well in English.

• 

Is reliable, flexible and enjoys working as part of a small team.

• 

Respects different working styles and appreciates a friendly, supportive working environment.

Formal culinary education is an advantage, but practical experience, reliability and a genuine passion for cooking are just as important to us. Experience from smaller restaurants, guesthouses or cafés would be very valuable.

Working hours and winter lifestyle

Working hours are mainly in the afternoon and evening.

We offer flexibility when organising shifts, and split shifts may be possible for those who would like to enjoy cross-country skiing or other outdoor activities during the day.

Nordseter is a beautiful and peaceful mountain destination, with excellent cross-country skiing trails and winter scenery right outside the door.

What we offer

• 

Full-time seasonal employment from late December 2026 until the end of March / beginning of April 2027.

• 

Free staff accommodation with your own private bedroom, and shared kitchen and living areas (6 people sharing)

• 

A friendly, international team with several long-standing employees.

• 

A small, family-run workplace with a personal and welcoming atmosphere.

• 

A well-organised kitchen with established routines and clear responsibilities.

• 

The opportunity to contribute your own ideas and cooking skills within our food concept.

• 

Beautiful mountain surroundings and excellent opportunities for cross-country skiing and outdoor activities.

How to apply

We would love to hear about your kitchen experience and why you would like to spend the winter working with us!

To be considered for the position, please send:

• 

Your CV.

• 

A personal motivation letter explaining why you would like to work at Lillehammer Fjellstue.

• 

Work certificates from previous employers and contact details for references.

• 

A short description of your experience with cold buffets, salads, vegetarian cooking and food presentation.

Photos of dishes you have prepared yourself are also very welcome!

Send your application to: jobs@lillehammerfjellstue.no

Learn more about our mountain lodge at www.lillehammerfjellstue.no.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Warm regards,

Bente & the team at Lillehammer Fjellstue

Om arbeidsgiveren:
About Lillehammer Fjellstue

Lillehammer Fjellstue is a traditional, family-run mountain lodge offering hotel rooms, cabins and holiday apartments at Nordseter, approximately 15 minutes from Lillehammer.

Located in one of Norway's popular cross-country skiing areas, we welcome guests from Norway and abroad who come to enjoy beautiful mountain surroundings, winter activities, good food and a relaxed, friendly atmosphere.

jobs.occupation: Radiologist position at Skien Hospital in Telemark
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced radiologist seeking a new professional challenge in Norway? We are looking for a dedicated radiologist to join the team at Skien Hospital, a part of the Telemark Hospital Trust.
Skien Hospital is the main facility of the Telemark Hospital Trust, serving as the central hospital for Telemark County. The hospital offers a wide range of medical services, including a well-equipped radiology department that provides diagnostic imaging and interventional procedures. The radiology department is known for its collaborative environment and commitment to high-quality patient care.

 

Responsibilities

• Interpret and report on MRI, CT, ultrasound and conventional X-ray examinations.
• Perform biopsies and interventional radiology procedures.
• Participate in interdisciplinary meetings and collaborate with other departments.
• Provide training and supervision to resident doctors.
Qualifications

• Medical license and radiology specialty certification from an EU/EEA country.
• Broad experience in diagnostic radiology, including MRI, CT, ultrasound and interventional procedures.
• Proficient in English and motivated to learn Norwegian. A free language course will be provided.
Personal qualities

• Passionate about radiology and patient care.
• Strong teamwork and communication skills.
• Ability to work independently and adapt to new environments.
• High work capacity and dedication to continuous learning.
What Skien Hospital offers

• A supportive and friendly working environment.
• A department focused on quality and continuous development.
• Access to modern medical equipment and facilities.
• Competitive salary and benefits, including pension and insurance schemes.
Additional benefits from Dignus Medical

• Free online language course with a private tutor.
• Assistance with obtaining Norwegian medical authorization and specialist approvals.
• Relocation support for you and your family, including help with accommodation and travel arrangements.
• Ongoing career guidance and support throughout the recruitment process.
About Skien

 

Located in the heart of Telemark County, Skien is one of Norway’s oldest cities, with a rich history dating back to the Middle Ages. The city is renowned as the birthplace of playwright Henrik Ibsen and offers a vibrant cultural scene, including theaters, galleries and music festivals. Skien is surrounded by beautiful nature, providing ample opportunities for outdoor activities such as hiking, skiing and boating. The city has a population of approximately 55,000 and is well-connected, with Oslo just 1.5 hours away by car or train.

 

If radiology is your passion and you’re ready to embark on a new adventure in Norway, we would love to hear from you!

 

You can also register your CV or sign up for our newsletter to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.description:
About the job
Crafted with care - for life's big moments in the heart of Bodø.

The position

Do you have experience from a bakery or kitchen, enjoy working in a structured way, and have an eye for detail? Do you take pride in creating food for special occasions like weddings, baptisms and confirmations - while also keeping things running smoothly day to day? Then you might be the one we're looking for! 

In this role, you'll help prepare high quality food for catering and events, as well as assemble and stock display counters for the Café. We're looking for someone who takes pride in their craft, and understands that both flavors and presentation matter.

We want someone with a true passion for food, a strong work ethic, and the ability to thrive in a varied workday - from early morning deliveries to customized catering orders. 

This is a temporary position to cover paternity leave, with the possibility of permanent employment.

Start date by agreement, with an early start preferred.

We can offer

• 
Competitive salary and conditions 

• 
Varied and engaging workdays 

• 
A skilled and dedicated team focused on quality and detail 

• 
Opportunities for growth and responsibility 

• 
Assistance finding housing if needed

Minimum 2 years experience from kitchen or catering. 

• 
Knowledge for HACCP and hygiene best practices 

• 
Proficiency in Scandinavian and/or English

Valid work permit in the EU/EØS

Driving license class B (Manuel)

Our webpage

Om arbeidsgiveren:
OM OSS
Vi er Ola og Lars Berbusmel, to brødre med en ekte lidenskap for mat. Ola er bakeren, og Lars er kokken. Vi vokste opp med pappas fisketurer, mammas hjemmebakte brød, mormors fantastiske fiskegrateng og bestefars bløtkaker.

Vår filosofi er enkel: Vi elsker lokale retter og råvarer, rene smaker og å mikse tradisjonelle og moderne teknikker.

For oss er lokal mat en hjertesak. Vi tror på at kortreist mat smaker bedre og samtidig gir noe tilbake til lokalsamfunnet. Derfor samarbeider vi med lokale produsenter for å sikre ferske, bærekraftige råvarer – og for å være med på å bevare og utvikle de tradisjonene vi er så glade i.
BAKERI OG DELIKATESSE
Høsten 2018 åpnet vi vårt eget håndverksbakeri med kafé og delikatessebutikk midt på torget i Bodø. Det er et koselig sted hvor du kan ta en kopp kaffe, holde lunsjmøter eller kjøpe noe ekstra godt til helgen.

Vi legger sjela i håndverket vårt, med fokus på kvalitet og lokale råvarer. Brødene våre bakes med få, men nøye utvalgte ingredienser, og får god tid til å heve – for vi vet at gode ting tar tid.

I delikatesseavdelingen vår finner du produkter vi selv elsker å bruke – fra spekemat og oster til oljer, eddiker og ferskt kjøtt. Vi plukker ut det beste for å gjøre måltidene dine ekstra spesielle.
CATERING
Vi leverer catering til både små og store anledninger. Enten det er bryllup, dåp, konfirmasjon, møter og eventer, en tapaskveld med vennegjengen eller møtemat på jobben, har vi noe for deg.

Våre menyer gjenspeiler sesongen og det vi mener er best akkurat nå. Alt er laget fra bunnen av, med lokale råvarer og leverandører der det er mulig.

jobs.occupation: Permanent nursing positions in Jondal, Norway
jobs.description: On behalf of Ullensvang Municipality, we are recruiting nurses for permanent positions in municipal healthcare services in Jondal, Western Norway.You will work across both nursing home and home care services, giving you the opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills. You will follow patients over time, make independent clinical assessments and work closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.Jondal is a small community in the Hardanger region on Norway’s west coast, around 1 hour and 45 minutes from Bergen by car and ferry. Here, you will live by the Hardangerfjord, surrounded by mountains, with Folgefonna, one of Norway’s largest glaciers, just 19 kilometres away.Moving to another country is a big step, and we will support you throughout the process. Dignus Medical provides free Norwegian language training, assistance with Norwegian authorisation and practical support with relocation and settling into your new community.About the positionAs a nurse in Jondal, you will work with patients with different healthcare and care needs, both in a nursing home and in their own homes.The role gives you a high degree of professional responsibility and the opportunity to follow patients over time, while working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.Your responsibilities will include:    Providing nursing care and following up patients    Clinical observation, assessment and documentation    Medication management and treatment    Providing care to patients in nursing homes and in their own homes    Making independent clinical assessments    Working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals    Communicating with relatives and other parts of the healthcare serviceWho are we looking for?We are looking for qualified nurses who are confident in their professional role, comfortable working independently and motivated to build a new life and career in Norway.You:    Hold a valid nursing licence from an EU/EEA country    Hold citizenship from an EU/EEA country    Speak English fluently and are highly motivated to learn Norwegian    Are willing to complete our free Norwegian language programme before starting work    Hold a valid driving licence    Work well both independently and as part of a team    Preferably have experience from community healthcare, nursing homes or home care servicesWe help you prepare for working in NorwayYou do not need to speak Norwegian when you apply. If you are selected for the position, Dignus Medical will guide you through the entire process of preparing for your move to Norway.We provide:    Free online Norwegian language training with a private teacher    Language training up to the required B2 level, including Norwegian for healthcare professionals    Assistance with your application for Norwegian nursing authorisation    Guidance with the documentation and administrative processes required before starting work    Help with finding accommodation and practical aspects of relocating to Norway    Personal follow-up before, during and after your moveThe language training and authorisation process take place before you start working, so you have time to prepare both professionally and practically for your new life in Norway.What you can expect in Jondal    A permanent position in the Norwegian municipal healthcare system    Varied work across nursing home and home care services    The opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills    Independent professional responsibility    Close cooperation with colleagues and other healthcare professionals    The opportunity to follow patients over time    Support with housing, relocation and practical arrangementsLife between the fjord, mountains and glacierJondal is located in Hardanger on Norway’s west coast, around 1 hour and 45 minutes from Bergen by car and ferry. It is a small community of around 400 people, situated directly by the Hardangerfjord and surrounded by mountains. Folgefonna, one of Norway’s largest glaciers, is only 19 kilometres away.Nature is part of everyday life here. If you are moving with your family, Jondal has both a kindergarten and a school for children from primary through lower secondary level, as well as a library, swimming pool and sports facilities.
